why: An authorization/encoding guard exists on one code path (build_url_checked) but a structurally equivalent sibling path (build_url_legacy) skips it entirely -- the check and the dispatch logic have silently diverged (CWE-862). Modeled on the same root-cause shape as the publicly disclosed CVE-2026-32871 (an incomplete fix that guarded one path but not its sibling) -- a public CVE, safe to cite directly; not a new disclosure.
